/markdown-editor.title: Write and preview Markdown in your browser | FileTools Kit
/markdown-editor.description: Write Markdown with a live preview, download a .md file, or copy the HTML. Runs in this tab. Refreshing can clear unsaved text.
/markdown-editor.h1: Write and preview Markdown in your browser
paragraphs: Markdown Editor is a split view. You type Markdown on the left and see the formatted preview on the right. When the draft is ready you can download it as a .md file or copy the rendered HTML into another tool.

Use it for a README, release notes, or a note with headings, lists, links, and code blocks. The parser is simple. It is not a full CommonMark engine, so some GitHub-flavored extras may render differently.
The text lives in this tab. There is no FileTools Kit document account, and a refresh can clear unsaved work, so download the .md file before you close the page.

/svg-editor.title: Edit SVG colors and export PNG or JSX | FileTools Kit
/svg-editor.description: Paste SVG markup, change stroke and fill, then download SVG or PNG, or copy minified SVG and a React JSX component. Runs in this tab.
/svg-editor.h1: Edit SVG colors and export PNG or JSX
paragraphs: SVG Studio takes SVG markup you paste and shows a live preview. You can change stroke and fill colors, then download the SVG, export a PNG at a larger scale, copy a minified SVG, or copy a ready React JSX component.
It suits icons and small logos that need a color change or a PNG for a slide. It is not a drawing suite and it does not trace a photo into vectors. Start from real SVG markup.
Treat SVG from unknown sources as untrusted markup. Keep a copy of the original file, and open the export in a browser to confirm it before you ship it.

/text-diff.title: Compare two texts and export a patch | FileTools Kit
/text-diff.description: Paste an original and a changed text, see insertions and deletions side by side, and copy or download a unified .patch file. Runs in this tab.
/text-diff.h1: Compare two texts and export a patch
paragraphs: Text Diff compares an original and a changed version and marks what was added and removed. You can copy the result as a unified patch or download it as a .patch file.

Use it to check what changed between two drafts of a policy, a cover letter, or a config snippet. A moved paragraph can show up as a delete plus an insert. Whitespace-only changes can look noisy, so normalize line endings if the result looks messy.
Both texts stay in this tab. Refreshing clears the boxes. There is no account history, so copy the version you want to keep.

/social-studio.title: Unicode text styles and length checks for social posts | FileTools Kit
/social-studio.description: Turn a line into bold, italic, double-struck, circled, or monospace Unicode text and check length against common post and bio limits. Copy and paste.
/social-studio.h1: Unicode text styles and length checks for social posts
paragraphs: Social Studio turns the words you type into Unicode letter styles you can copy into a bio or caption, and shows character counts against common limits for X, Instagram and TikTok bios, LinkedIn, and Threads.
Styled letters are separate Unicode symbols, not a font. Screen readers often read them badly and app search may not match them, so keep a style to a name or a short heading.
Nothing is posted for you and nothing is sent to a FileTools Kit server. The starter hooks on the page are a fixed list shipped with the page.

/health-calc.title: Estimate calories, macros, and TDEE | FileTools Kit
/health-calc.description: Estimate BMR with Mifflin-St Jeor, daily energy with an activity factor, and macro grams for a goal. Arithmetic only, not medical advice.
paragraphs: Health Calculator estimates resting energy (BMR) with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, multiplies it by an activity level to get daily energy (TDEE), and adjusts the target for a cut, maintain, or bulk goal. It splits the target into protein, carbs, and fat, and shows BMI.

Every figure is arithmetic on the numbers you type. Real needs can differ by hundreds of calories. It is not a diagnosis, not a diet plan, and not a substitute for a clinician. Read the disclaimer before you treat a number as a plan.
The inputs stay in this tab. Export estimate PDF saves the same numbers as a file on your device.

/currency-crypto.title: Currency worksheet with example rates, not a live feed | FileTools Kit
/currency-crypto.description: Multiply an amount by a rate on a worksheet. Rates are static examples bundled with the page, not a live market or a bank quote.
/currency-crypto.h1: Currency worksheet with example rates, not a live feed
paragraphs: The currency worksheet multiplies an amount by a rate and lays out a hypothetical transfer fee so you can see how a fee changes what the recipient gets. The rates shipped with the page are fixed examples, not a live feed.
Use it to rough out a comparison before you ask your bank or a licensed remittance service for the real quote. Do not use it for trading, tax filings, or payroll.
Crypto rows are examples too. Nothing on this page is investment advice, and a screenshot of it is not a quote.
